ingestion_contract.seed: Explicit CLI with start/end/as-of/dataset-version/checkpoint options; normal API startup no longer seeds.

coverage: future publication excluded before freshness ranking
wrong dataset version excluded before ranking
late-retrieved and unknown-time historical evidence excluded
